text.p: Hale Irwin fired a four-under-par 68 Sunday to win the $1 million Mastercard Championship by two strokes over Gil Morgan in the first event on the 1997 Senior PGA Tour.
Irwin picked up right where he left off in 1996, when he won two events, finished second seven other times and earned more than $1.2 million, the second-highest total on the Senior Tour.
Irwin finished with a three-round total of seven-under-par 209 and won $186,000. He shook off Morgan at the par-3 17th hole, where he birdied and Morgan three-putted for bogey.
Morgan shot 70 for five-under 211, two shots better than Bob Charles, who carded a 69.
